editorial:
Casey Bowman is a martial-arts master living a quiet life with his wife, until a brutal attack shatters everything he loves. Vowing revenge, he tracks the killer across Osaka, Bangkok, and Rangoon with help from his wise sensei. His only clues are victims strangled by barbed wire, leading him toward a sinister drug lord named Goro. The vibe is gritty and intense, mixing old-school ninja action with a revenge story that keeps you on edge from the very first scene.

The fight scenes are the real star here, with sharp choreography and brutal hand-to-hand combat that feels raw and real. Scott Adkins delivers a strong physical performance, and the pacing rarely slows down. The story is simple but effective, though some plot twists feel a bit rushed. If you love martial-arts movies with no-nonsense action, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Casey corners Goro at his jungle drug factory and defeats him in a brutal showdown. But the real twist comes when Casey learns his sensei, Nakabara, was secretly working with Goro all along. The man who helped him track the killer was actually part of the conspiracy. Casey realizes he truly can trust no one, and his battle is far from over. He walks away knowing the ninja code of survival means staying invisible and always watching your back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves martial-arts action and revenge stories.
